\section[(dialogue)]{The body, the family and the house — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R68-first-pass-the-body-the-family-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a monkey and a snake.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the head, a leg, the belly, a tooth, hair
  \item a finger, the throat, a shoulder, a lip, the tongue
  \item a knee, the heart, blood, a fever, a cough
  \item pain, medicine, rest, hunger, thirst
  \item happiness, anger, fear, worry, tiredness
  \item father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, a child
  \item uncle, aunt, uncle, aunt, a husband
  \item a wife, a son, a daughter, a relative, a guest
  \item to sit, to walk, to get up, to sleep, to play
  \item to cook, to wash, to give, to bring, to drink
  \item to sing, to dance, to laugh, to listen, to learn
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The head? (\textbf{\gu{માથું}}.) A leg? (\textbf{\gu{પગ}}.) The belly? (\textbf{\gu{પેટ}}.) A tooth? (\textbf{\gu{દાંત}}.) Hair? (\textbf{\gu{વાળ}}.) A finger? (\textbf{\gu{આંગળી}}.) The throat? (\textbf{\gu{ભૂખ}}.) Thirst? (\textbf{\gu{તરસ}}.) Happiness? (\textbf{\gu{ખુશી}}.) Anger? (\textbf{\gu{ગુસ્સો}}.) Fear? (\textbf{\gu{બીક}}.) Worry? (\textbf{\gu{ચિંતા}}.) Tiredness? (\textbf{\gu{થાક}}.) Father? (\textbf{\gu{પિતા}}.) Mother? (\textbf{\gu{માતા}}.) Grandfather? (\textbf{\gu{દાદા}}.) Grandmother? (\textbf{\gu{દાદી}}.) A child? (\textbf{\gu{બાળક}}.) Uncle? A daughter? (\textbf{\gu{દીકરી}}.) A relative? (\textbf{\gu{સંબંધી}}.) A guest? (\textbf{\gu{મહેમાન}}.) To sit? (\textbf{\gu{બેસવું}}.) To walk? (\textbf{\gu{ચાલવું}}.) To get up?
